sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KAILASH PRASAD DEO -------

For the Appellant : Mr. Nikhil Ranjan, Advocate For the Respondent No.1 : Mr. Pratyush Kumar, Advocate  --------
The matter is being taken up through Video Conferencing.
Learned counsel for the parties have no objection with it and submitted that audio and video qualities are good.
Order No.09/Dated: 10th May, 2023

The appellant-Raj Kumar Rai, son of Ram Prasad Rai, who is the owner of offending vehicle bearing registration No.JH-05C-6898 has preferred the instant Miscellaneous Appeal against the part of the award dated 10.02.2016, passed by the District Judge-III cum Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Seraikella in Compensation Case No. 60 of 2004,
whereby the claimant, namely, Sumitra Mahato, daughter of Mahendra Mahato has been awarded compensation to the tune of Rs.1,22,725/- along with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim application i.e. 05.10.2004 till the date of its realization after deducting the amount if already paid to the claimant under Section 140 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

Mr. Nikhil Ranjan, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant has submitted that though the award was passed and pursuant thereto the National Insurance Company Limited has indemnified the award but unnecessary right of recovery has been given to the Insurance Company to realize the compensation amount from the owner of the offending vehicle after indemnifying the award.

With regard to the driving license of the driver of the offending vehicle, the learned Tribunal has considered that the plea taken by the Insurance Company that the driver was not having any driving license at the relevant time so he is not responsible to indemnify rather the owner of the vehicle is responsible and in this regard, his document i.e. notice dated 07.10.2006 also reveals that during investigation, Insurance Company has issued said notice to the opposite party No.2 (owner)
Raj Kumar Rai vs National Insurance Company Limited & ... on 10 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193364710/
1 to produce the driving license of the driver of the vehicle but he could not do the same and during proceeding of this case, the opposite party No.2 has also not turned up to give any response in this case and, as such, the appellant has filed I.A. No. 5148 of 2022 with an averment at paragraph Nos.2 to 5 that notice was returned unserved.

sentences.text: Thereafter, substituted service of notice was made through the newspaper, named, "Rajdhani Jagran" but the same was not having widely circulation in Jamshedpur and, as such, the driving license has been brought on record along with the Interlocutory Application filed under Order XLI Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure.

Learned counsel for the appellant has further submitted that there is a delay of 982 days in filing the instant Miscellaneous Appeal and for condonation of the same, I.A. No. 2608 of 2022 has been filed.

Mr. Pratyush Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf Insurance Company has submitted that the owners of the vehicle are generally delaying the process in Motor Accident Claim Cases as the right of recovery has rightly been given in favour of the Insurance Company because even after taking such plea and taking steps by the Insurance Company, the owner has not co-operated with the proceeding.

Learned counsel for the Insurance Company has further submitted that the driver of the vehicle,
namely, Santosh Gorai was an accused, against which, charge-sheet has been submitted under Sections 279, 337 and 338 of the Indian Penal Code.

The owner was well-acquainted with the fact and thus he got released his vehicle but even after issuance of summon issued by the learned Tribunal, he has managed to return it and subsequently he did not appear even after substituted service of notice.

Learned counsel for the Insurance Company has further submitted that even the Insurance Company has requested the owner to produce the driving license by writing an application, but he did not take care for the same as recorded by the learned Tribunal at paragraph No.9 and then this award was passed.

The Insurance Company has preferred an appeal before this Court for the purpose of shifting the liability upon the owner by exonerating the Insurance Company vide M.A.
No. 417 of 2016, which was dismissed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 10.06.2022.

Learned counsel for the Insurance Company has further submitted that to contest this case and to oppose the condonation of delay of 982 days as well as on the application for the additional evidence, which is not in the spirit of law under Order XLI Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure, he may be allowed two weeks' time to file a detail counter affidavit in both Interlocutory Applications as well as in the memo of appeal, so that the fact of the case of the Insurance Company may be brought before this Court.
Considering the same, let the matter be listed on 21.06.2023.

In the meantime, learned counsel for the Insurance Company is directed to file detail counter affidavit in the memo of appeal and both Interlocutory Applications after serving a copy of the same to the learned counsel for the owner.

(Kailash Prasad Deo, J.) Madhav/-
